topics.topic: How STOP_SIGNALS names are resolved without prescribing lookup mechanics
questions: Replace the prescribed indexing operation and attribute-lookup prohibition with a behavioral requirement to resolve every imported STOP_SIGNALS name to its corresponding operating-system signal and install its handler unconditionally, without specifying the expression or access mechanism.

Replace the indexing and attribute-lookup implementation prescription with a behavioral requirement that calls a separately declared imported port responsible for resolving a STOP_SIGNALS name to the corresponding operating-system signal member.

The passage must state the required signal-handling behavior without prescribing enumeration indexing or attribute-access mechanics; if the exact lookup mechanism is contractual, declare it as a separate port or contract.

quotes: Each name of the imported STOP_SIGNALS constant selects the member of that name of the operating system's signal enumeration by indexing the enumeration with the name, never by attribute lookup; every such signal exists on the Linux host, so its handler is installed unconditionally and its presence is never tested.
judgement.why: The note prescribes enumeration indexing and forbids an alternative access mechanism instead of stating only the required behavior or declaring the exact lookup mechanism as a separate port or contract.
judgement.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены. Нормативные значения размещаются процедурой 15.2 и адресуются ссылкой. Если точный внешний способ извлечения значения является частью контракта, он объявляется отдельным портом/контрактом, а не прячется псевдокодом в note.
